tagline.zh: 从屏幕边缘 transform 滑入的面板:不离开当前页即可承载子任务/表单/详情,Esc 关闭、可带遮罩,reduced-motion 直达。
tagline.en: A panel that transform-slides in from a screen edge: hosts subtasks/forms/details without leaving the page, closes on Esc, optional mask, instant under reduced-motion.

origin.zh: 定位取自 Ant Design Drawer 官方描述:从屏幕边缘滑入、承载一组信息或动作,适用于「Form 中创建/编辑」「子任务对 Popover 太重但需留在主任务上下文」;placement 默认 right、size 默认 378/736、Esc 默认开启均按 antd 6.7.1 核对(调研 07§4 与 design-study 06§4.12)。
origin.en: Positioning follows the official Ant Design Drawer description: a panel sliding in from the screen edge carrying a set of info or actions, for 'create/edit in a form', 'subtasks too heavy for a Popover but kept in the main-task context'; placement default right, size default 378/736, Esc on by default, all per antd 6.7.1 (research 07 §4, design-study 06 §4.12).

effect.zh: 滑入边缘(JS 型参数)。AntD Drawer placement 默认 **right**(四方位 top/right/bottom/left);右侧抽屉贴合「详情/表单子任务」的主流布局(内容左、操作右)。
effect.en: The edge it slides from (JS-type param). AntD Drawer placement defaults to **right** (four positions top/right/bottom/left); right-side drawers match the mainstream 'details/form subtask' layout (content left, actions right).

effect.zh: 抽屉厚度:左右抽屉为宽度、上下抽屉为高度(CSS 变量型参数)。官方核对:AntD Drawer size 默认档 **378px**、large 档 **736px**(旧 width/height 默认 378 已废弃,demo 用单一厚度参数统一表达);范围 240–560 为演示收敛值。
effect.en: Drawer thickness: width for left/right drawers, height for top/bottom ones (CSS-var param). Verified: AntD Drawer size default is **378px**, large **736px** (legacy width/height defaulting to 378 are deprecated; the demo expresses both with a single thickness param); the 240–560 range is a demo narrowing.

effect.zh: 是否渲染遮罩(JS 型参数)。AntD Drawer mask 默认 **true**;mask=false 时页面仍可交互(「看着抽屉同时操作页面」),点遮罩关闭随之失效,Esc 关闭仍保留(antd keyboard 默认 true)。
effect.en: Whether a mask renders (JS-type param). AntD Drawer mask defaults to **true**; with mask=false the page stays interactive (operate the page while watching the drawer), mask-click closing goes away, Esc close remains (antd keyboard default true).

note.zh: 实现只依赖 absolute 定位 + transform 过渡 + 焦点 API,均为 Baseline;prefers-reduced-motion 全浏览器可用(调研 07§37)。
note.en: Implementation only needs absolute positioning + transform transitions + the focus API, all Baseline; prefers-reduced-motion is universally supported (research 07 §37).

fallback.zh: 不支持 transform 过渡的旧环境抽屉直接出现/消失(信息不受影响);不支持 CSS 变量时厚度取 378px 硬值;JS 失效时抽屉无法触发,导航类内容需要另有静态入口。
fallback.en: Without transform transitions the drawer simply appears/disappears (content unaffected); without CSS variables thickness falls back to a hard 378px; with JS disabled the drawer cannot open, so navigation-type content needs a static entry elsewhere.

use.zh: 在 Form 中创建/编辑一组信息,不离开主任务上下文(AntD 官方场景)
use.en: Create/edit a group of info inside a form without leaving the main task (official AntD scenario)

use.zh: 对 Popover 太重、对整页又太轻的子任务(详情预览、筛选条件)
use.en: Subtasks too heavy for a Popover yet too light for a full page (detail previews, filters)

use.zh: 多处以同一 Form 复用的编辑面板
use.en: An edit panel reusing the same form from many places

use.zh: 窄屏导航(左侧滑入)+ 多级抽屉处理分支任务(push 推挤)
use.en: Narrow-screen navigation (slides from left) + multi-level drawers for branching tasks (push)

avoid.zh: 必须处理的阻断信息——用 Dialog(alertdialog)
avoid.en: Blocking, must-act information — use a Dialog (alertdialog)

avoid.zh: 轻量确认/提示——Drawer 开销过大,用 Dialog 或 toast
avoid.en: Light confirmations/hints — a Drawer is overkill; use Dialog or toast

avoid.zh: 超过两屏的长内容——直接开页面,避免抽屉内长滚动
avoid.en: Content beyond two screens — open a page instead of long in-drawer scrolling

a11y.zh: 面板 role=dialog + aria-modal(带遮罩时 true);打开焦点进面板、Tab 困焦(6.2.0 起可用 focusable 配置焦点陷阱)、Esc 关闭(antd keyboard 默认 true)、关闭后焦点回触发元素;mask=false 时面板非模态,不应困焦;transform 大位移动画必须在 prefers-reduced-motion 下直达(MDN)。
a11y.en: Panel gets role=dialog + aria-modal (true when masked); focus enters on open, Tab is trapped (focus trap configurable via `focusable` since 6.2.0), Esc closes (antd keyboard default true), focus returns to the trigger on close; with mask=false the panel is non-modal and must not trap; the large transform travel must collapse to instant under prefers-reduced-motion (MDN).

goal.zh: 复刻一个边缘滑入抽屉:placement 决定滑入边、厚度按参数、可开关遮罩、transform 过渡滑入滑出,Esc 关闭且 reduced-motion 直达。
goal.en: Replicate an edge-sliding drawer: placement picks the edge, thickness follows the parameter, mask toggles, transform transitions in/out, Esc closes, instant under reduced-motion.

acceptance.zh: 面板 transform: translate 滑入滑出(不用 width/height 动画)
acceptance.en: Panel slides via transform: translate (never animating width/height)

acceptance.zh: placement/thickness/mask 严格使用参数快照值
acceptance.en: placement/thickness/mask use the exact parameter snapshot values

acceptance.zh: 带遮罩时 role=dialog + aria-modal=true、Tab 困焦;Esc 关闭;焦点归还触发元素
acceptance.en: With mask: role=dialog + aria-modal=true, Tab trapped; Esc closes; focus returns to the trigger

acceptance.zh: prefers-reduced-motion 时取消过渡直达终态
acceptance.en: prefers-reduced-motion collapses the transition to instant
